'''''Cachrys''''' is a genus of [[flowering plant]] in the family [[Apiaceae]].<ref name=POWO_39758-1/><ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Tahar |first1=Smaili |last2=Hamdi |first2=Bendif |last3=Flamini |first3=Guido |last4=Mehmet |first4=Öztürk |last5=Duru |first5=Mehmet Emin |last6=Bruno |first6=Maurizio |last7=Maggi |first7=Filippo |date=2021-09-10 |title=Chemical composition, antioxidant and anticholinesterase activity of the essential oil of {{sic|nolink=y|reason=error in source|algerian}} cachrys sicula L |url=https://doi.org/10.1080/14786419.2021.1969567 |journal=Natural Product Research |volume=36 |issue=16 |pages=4094–4102 |doi=10.1080/14786419.2021.1969567 |issn=1478-6419 |pmid=34507514|s2cid=237479574 |url-access=subscription }}</ref> Its species are native around the [[Mediterranean Sea|Mediterranean]] and eastwards to [[Iran]].<ref name=POWO_39758-1/>
